title: Process handover practice
goal: Combine inspection, state changes, priority and logout survival in a readable handover.
challenge: Create bounded owned practice tasks, identify their actual PIDs and niceness, pause/continue one and terminate it narrowly. Keep a positively niced task alive across controlled logout, save a guest-local handover with your observations, then verify and clean up. Explain what disk Resume does not preserve. Equivalent commands and order are acceptable.

steps.explanation: Keep this exercise's notes and PID records in the guest.
steps.expected: The directory is guest-local, not included in profile backups.

steps.explanation: Create the temporary task you will manage and finish.
steps.expected: A bounded owned task starts; record its actual PID.

steps.explanation: Launch the intended survivor with lower scheduling priority and explicit streams.
steps.expected: One bounded protected task starts. This does not preserve it across reboot.
Its identity can be re-inspected after logout.

steps.explanation: Match each task with its role.
steps.expected: The ordinary task normally has NI 0, and the protected task NI 10.

steps.explanation: Suspend only the temporary task. A snapshot can race the signal; repeat ps if needed.
steps.expected: The task becomes T; it is not terminated.

steps.explanation: Continue, then terminate and reap only that task.
steps.expected: The survivor is unaffected; ps can confirm the first task is gone.

steps.explanation: Save a snapshot as part of your handover, then add your own explanation with a guest editor or printf.
steps.expected: The guest-local report records the survivor; it is your evidence, not app-verified assessment.

steps.explanation: Use the same shell-local controlled logout experiment.
steps.expected: tty1 autologins a new learner shell. The protected task remains; the new job table is empty.

steps.explanation: Check current identity and NI, and compare with your saved observation.
steps.expected: The survivor is still an owned sleep with NI 10; its parent may have changed.

steps.explanation: After verifying identity, finish the survivor.
steps.expected: It ends; a final ps should have no matching row. Keep the note until Reset if you want to review it.

hints: Describe actual observations, including any changing PIDs or process states.
A saved report does not prove a process is still alive; inspect again before signaling.
Cleanup is part of the handover. Disk Resume retains files, never running processes or shell jobs.
review: I identified the tasks, states and actual nice values.
My targeted signals left the intended survivor unaffected.
I verified the survivor after controlled logout and wrote a meaningful handover.
I cleaned up and explained self-review, backup exclusions and disk Resume.
coverage: Real guest practice; completion is self-reviewed, with no guest assessment or verification score. Partial LPIC-1 103.5, 103.6 coverage.
